comparison: One A/B pair per model. Both can freely analyze exact history, return fitted findings, invent complete methods and select existing methods. B additionally sees the complete measured leader program and can submit exact edits bound to a valid canonical source identity. This bundled access/reuse treatment is not a clean per-token or syntax-only effect.
data: UCI189; 28train/7development/7final entire patients;3900/945/1030rows. Hash ordering is label-independent. Neither final rows nor labels are exposed before all trajectories freeze. See data-audit.json.
milestone: At least5%relative final RMSE improvement without equal-patient MAE >5%worse than reference. Every trajectory and failure remains in denominator.
question: Does direct access to the exact measured leader source plus optional bound edits reduce misremembered parents and invalid one-factor claims, while supporting useful new methods for unseen patients?
research_evaluation: Manually inspect every proposal before final metrics: claimed parent versus actual source, whether stated one-factor control is preserved, use of measured counterexamples, new representations beyond parameter variation, numerical versus semantic errors. Report exact-edit uptake and failures separately. Operator evaluations are not agent-discovered findings.
resources: high effort,32768output,200000sharedtokens,up to2responses,HTTP600s/outer1500s;7rounds;1CPUthread/worker,4GiB,600sprogram/660saction/720snative;14400CPUwall/project. Both arms65536prompt bytes, optional8192-byte computed findings. No GPU/service changes.
scope: One familiar public voice dataset, seven heldout patients, one pair per model. Research-quality coding is interpretive, not blinded. Cannot prove clinical utility, causal disease mechanisms, literature novelty, or stable general research improvement.
selection: Explicit select or lowest valid development row RMSE at7rounds, ties earliest. Initial reference best of3 on development. Same selected source refitted on train+development for final.
source_review: Every expanded program manually reviewed before native execution. Worker independently resolves edits from the bound history; driver verifies requested and actual full source and independently scores predictions. Source checks are review aids, not sandboxes.
